set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KYSSZRDP783ZZ20EC7CK28M4. PRD phase PH4. Covers GEO-001 through GEO-007, REF-002, and LAW-005. Implement packed PointField, SurfaceRealization, multiple-realization ownership, scale-aware nondegeneracy evidence, unit-bearing PiecewiseEuclideanMetric, induced metrics, and narrow D2 or D3 geometry. Enforce exact stored-Double triangle inequalities and layer any conditioning margin explicitly. Exit when primitive coordinate traversal allocates no Point per vertex and optimized geometry agrees with the independent oracle under stated tolerances.
set.title: PH4: packed realizations and intrinsic metrics
